且记内置以下开源运行资源，用于断网时正常打开界面：

React 18.3.1
Copyright (c) Facebook, Inc. and its affiliates.
License: MIT
https://github.com/facebook/react

React DOM 18.3.1
Copyright (c) Facebook, Inc. and its affiliates.
License: MIT
https://github.com/facebook/react

构建前端文件时使用以下开源工具；它不会随应用运行：

Babel Standalone 7.29.0

License: MIT
https://github.com/babel/babel
